description: Sample multi-stack audit rules for the codebase-auditor PoC

rules.title: Do not use eval on untrusted input
rules.rule: Flag any use of eval() or exec() on data that may come from users, requests, files, or environment input. Prefer safe parsers (json, ast.literal_eval) or explicit allowlists.

rules.title: No hardcoded secrets
rules.rule: Flag API keys, passwords, tokens, or connection strings assigned as string literals in source. Secrets must come from environment variables or a secret manager.

rules.title: Parameterize SQL queries
rules.rule: Flag SQL built with string concatenation or f-strings that include variables. Queries must use parameterized placeholders.

rules.title: Avoid print() in production paths
rules.rule: Flag print() calls in lib/ (non-test) code. Prefer a logging package with levels so production builds can silence debug output.

rules.title: HTTP clients must set timeouts
rules.rule: Flag HttpClient or package:http calls that never set a connection or request timeout. Network calls without timeouts can hang the UI isolate.

rules.title: No hardcoded API keys in Dart
rules.rule: Flag string literals that look like API keys, Bearer tokens, or secret credentials in Dart source. Load them from --dart-define, secure storage, or backend config.

rules.title: Do not concatenate SQL strings
rules.rule: Flag SQL statements built by concatenating user-controlled strings. Use PreparedStatement or a typed query API.

rules.title: Do not log secrets
rules.rule: Flag log statements that include password, token, apiKey, secret, or authorization header values.

rules.title: Close IO resources
rules.rule: Flag InputStream, Connection, or Statement usage outside try-with-resources when the resource is opened in the same method.

globalRules.title: Track FIXME / SECURITY TODOs
globalRules.rule: Report FIXME, XXX, or TODO comments that mention security, auth, crypto, or password so they are tracked rather than forgotten.
